title: TheErrorExe's Capes
description: Fetch Capes from NoRiskClient, LabyMod and more
body:
**This Mod fetches Capes from NoRiskClient, LabyMod, Optifine and other Cape Clients/Mods without installing them.**


The Mod will use API's like the LabyMod API to fetch the Capes.
Example:
![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48cae2b424e87a9f03771e4ae988f3d81948b9ef_0.webp)


You can configure the Mod in the Config Menu. 
Example:
![Configuration Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/189a2efde7caec922b2150fcfc0bfbed44fba586_0.webp)
